title: Oil finishes lower as the market sniffs out a TACO
description: WTI crude oil on the November contract is trading down $1.64 to $95.60. That's something of a win for the bears, as it finished last week at $95.94. Since then, we've had a mixed series of updates on the pipeline attacks in Saudi Arabia but the latest ones say they're doing bypasses of the damaged pumping stations and could soon have half of the lost supply back online. I'd take those reports with the usual grain of salt but coupled with large transits through Hormuz and there's a plausible case for the bears. The x-factor remains Hormuz.
